problem.passage:
A city's transportation department is comparing the number of riders on two new bus routes since they began operating. Route 1's ridership $y$ (number of daily riders) after $x$ weeks of operation is modeled by line $p$, and Route 2's ridership is modeled by line $q$, both shown in the figure. The department wants to know after how many weeks the two routes will have the same number of daily riders.

After how many weeks do Route 1 and Route 2 have the same number of daily riders?

problem.question: After how many weeks do Route 1 and Route 2 have the same number of daily riders?
problem.explanation:
선 $p$는 $y = 5x + 20$이고, 선 $q$는 $y = -3x + 84$이다(그래프에서 $y$절편과 기울기를 각각 읽는다). 두 노선의 승객 수가 같아지는 시점을 구하려면 연립방정식을 푼다.

$$\begin{cases} y = 5x + 20 \\ y = -3x + 84 \end{cases}$$

$5x + 20 = -3x + 84$에서 $8x = 64$이므로 $x = 8$. 따라서 8주 후에 두 노선의 일일 승객 수가 같아진다.
problem.explanationEn:
Line $p$ has equation $y = 5x + 20$ and line $q$ has equation $y = -3x + 84$ (reading the $y$-intercept and slope of each line from the graph). To find when the two routes have equal ridership, solve the system:

$$\begin{cases} y = 5x + 20 \\ y = -3x + 84 \end{cases}$$

Setting the expressions equal: $5x + 20 = -3x + 84$, so $8x = 64$ and $x = 8$. Therefore, after 8 weeks, the two bus routes have the same number of daily riders.
